ayahs.1: Qasam hai bikherne waaliyon ki uda kar.
ayahs.4: Phir kaam ko taqseem karne waaliyan.
ayahs.5: Yaqeen maano ke tum se jo waade kiye jaate hain (sab) sachche hain.
ayahs.6: Aur beshak insaaf hone wala hai.
ayahs.7: Qasam hai raahon waale aasmaan ki.
ayahs.8: Yaqeenan tum mukhtalif baat mein pade hue ho.
ayahs.9: Is se wohi baaz rakha jaata hai jo pher diya gaya ho.
ayahs.10: Be-sanad baatein karne wale ghaarat kar diye gaye.
ayahs.11: Jo ghaflat mein hain aur bhoole hue hain.
ayahs.12: Poochhte hain ke yaum-e-jaza kab hoga?
ayahs.13: Haan yeh woh din hai ke yeh aag par tapaaye jaayenge.
ayahs.14: Apni fitna-pardaazee ka maza chakho, yehi hai jis ki tum jaldi macha rahe the.
ayahs.15: Beshak taqwa wale log bahishton aur chashmon mein honge.
ayahs.16: Un ke Rabb ne jo kuchh unhein ata farmaaya hai ise le rahe honge woh to is se pehle hi nekokaar the.
ayahs.17: Woh raat ko bahut kam soya karte the.
ayahs.18: Aur waqt-e-sahar istighfaar kiya karte the.
ayahs.19: Aur un ke maal mein maangne walon ka aur sawaal se bachne walon ka haq tha.
ayahs.20: Aur yaqeen walon ke liye to zameen mein bahut si nishaniyan hain.
ayahs.21: Aur khud tumhari zaat mein bhi, to kya tum dekhte nahin ho.
ayahs.22: Aur tumhari rozi aur jo tum se waada kiya jaata hai sab aasman mein hai.
ayahs.23: Aasman-o-zameen ke Parwardigaar ki qasam! Ke yeh bilkul barhaq hai aisa hi jaise ke tum baatein karte ho.
ayahs.24: Kya tujhe Ibraheem (alaihis salaam) ke muazzaz mehmanon ki khabar bhi pahunchi hai?
ayahs.25: Woh jab un ke haan aaye to salaam kiya, Ibraheem ne jawab-e-salaam diya (aur kaha yeh to) ajnabi log hain.
ayahs.26: Phir (chup chaap jaldi jaldi) apne ghar walon ki taraf gaye aur ek farba bachhde (ka gosht) laaye.
ayahs.27: Aur ise un ke paas rakha aur kaha Aap khaate kyun nahin.
ayahs.28: Phir to dil hi dil mein un se khauf-zada ho gaye unhon ne kaha Aap khauf na kijiye. Aur unhon ne is (Hazrat Ibraheem) ko ek ilm wale ladke ki basharat di.
ayahs.29: Pas un ki biwi aage badhi aur hairat mein aa kar apne munh par haath maar kar kaha ke main to boodhiyaa hoon aur saath hi baanjh.
ayahs.30: Unhon ne kaha haan tere Parwardigaar ne isi tarah farmaaya hai, beshak woh Hakeem-o-Aleem hai.
ayahs.31: (Hazrat Ibraheem alaihis salaam) ne kaha ke Allah ke bheje hue (farishto!) tumhara kya maqsad hai?
ayahs.32: Unhon ne jawab diya ke hum gunaahgaar qaum ki taraf bheje gaye hain.
ayahs.33: Taake hum un par mitti ke kankar barsaayen.
ayahs.34: Jo tere Rabb ki taraf se nishaan-zada hain, un hadd se guzar jaane walon ke liye.
ayahs.35: Pas jitne imaan wale wahan the hum ne unhein nikaal liya.
ayahs.36: Aur hum ne wahan musalmanon ka sirf ek hi ghar paaya.
ayahs.37: Aur wahan hum ne un ke liye jo dardnaak azaab ka dar rakhte hain ek (kaamil) alaamat chhodi.
ayahs.38: Moosa (alaihis salaam ke qisse) mein (bhi hamari taraf se tanbeeh hai) ke hum ne ise Firaun ki taraf khuli daleel de kar bheja.
ayahs.39: Pas is ne apne balboote par munh moda aur kehne laga yeh jaadugar hai ya deewaana hai.
ayahs.40: Bil-aakhir hum ne ise aur is ke lashkaron ko apne azaab mein pakad kar darya mein daal diya woh tha hi malaamat ke qaabil.
ayahs.41: Isi tarah Aadiyon mein bhi (hamari taraf se tanbeeh hai) jab ke hum ne un par khair-o-barkat se khaali aandhi bheji.
ayahs.42: Woh jis jis cheez par girti thi ise boseeda haddee ki tarah (choora choora) kar deti thi.
ayahs.43: Aur Samood (ke qisse) mein bhi (ibrat) hai jab un se kaha gaya ke tum kuchh dinon tak faida utha lo.
ayahs.44: Lekin unhon ne apne Rabb ke hukm se sartaabi ki jis par unhein un ke dekhte dekhte (tez-o-tund) kadaake ne halaak kar diya.
ayahs.45: Pas na to woh khade ho sake aur na badla le sake.
ayahs.46: Aur Nooh (alaihis salaam) ki qaum ka bhi is se pehle (yehi haal ho chuka tha) woh bhi bade na-farmaan log the.
ayahs.47: Aasman ko hum ne (apne) haathon se banaaya hai aur yaqeenan hum kushaadgi karne wale hain.
ayahs.48: Aur zameen ko hum ne farsh bana diya hai pas hum bahut hi achhe bichhaane wale hain.
ayahs.49: Aur har cheez ko hum ne joda joda paida kiya hai taake tum naseehat haasil karo.
ayahs.50: Pas tum Allah ki taraf daud bhaag (yaani ruju) karo, yaqeenan main tumhein is ki taraf se saaf saaf tanbeeh karne wala hoon.
ayahs.51: Aur Allah ke saath kisi aur ko mabood na thahraao. Beshak main tumhein is ki taraf se khula daraane wala hoon.
ayahs.52: Isi tarah jo log un se pehle guzre hain un ke paas jo bhi Rasool aaya unhon ne keh diya ke ya to yeh jaadugar hai ya deewaana hai.
ayahs.53: Kya yeh is baat ki ek doosre ko wasiyat karte gaye hain.
ayahs.54: (Nahin) balke yeh sab ke sab sarkash hain. To Aap un se munh pher len Aap par koi malaamat nahin.
ayahs.55: Aur naseehat karte rahen yaqeenan yeh naseehat imaan walon ko nafa degi.
ayahs.56: Main ne jinnat aur insaanon ko mehaz isi liye paida kiya hai ke woh sirf meri ibaadat karen.
ayahs.57: Na main un se rozi chahta hoon na meri yeh chahat hai ke yeh mujhe khilaayen.
ayahs.58: Allah Taala to khud hi sab ka rozee-rasaan tawanaai wala aur zor-aawar hai.
ayahs.59: Pas jin logon ne zulm kiya hai unhein bhi un ke saathiyon ke hisse ke misl hissa milega, lihaza woh mujh se jaldi talab na karen.
ayahs.60: Pas kharabi hai munkiron ko un ke is din ki jis ka waada diye jaate hain.
